about: Each dealer's compositions (Jakob 2026-11-23): two or more of her node trees (data/dealer-trees.json, by id; a further way of a tree, such as tatuerad-nyp, by its own id) put together into one larger tree that the lab's game plays with ?komposition=<id>. Where the ways of one tree are put together, the shares are how often each way is played (Tatuerad: skjut + nyp). trees: each tree and its share (80 and 20; share 0: the tree only lends what the others lack). bridges: where two trees may meet although their pictures differ, by the two pictures' entry ids in data/media-roles.json (A1 of one tree and A1 of another, or their anchors at the shoe); ab and ba are the bridge films each way (a path under assets/), and without one that way is a plain cut. shares: a film's share among the films of its own step, by take id. Rules and words: src/composition.ts. Written by Karta (studio/components/map/CompositionKarta.tsx) through tools/dealer-composition.ts.
